question: Do the five common single-mask J2 symmetries generate additional XOR invariances, and do they provide keep-g witnesses for the four unresolved class toggles?
number: All 32 masks in the XOR span of {00001000,00002000,04000000,20000000,80000000} preserve the exact J2 relation for both epsilon rows; q=ROR12(delta) is outside the span for every unresolved delta, with paired counts 0/0 for 03e00000, 00001000, 00000400 and half-base paired counts for 00002000.
notes: Exact finite carry-DP result for J2 only. It neither proves nor refutes coupled J1/J3 class invariance; no saving credited.
